messages.text: The rack refund proposal is for **BRL 119.00**. Please confirm it using the button on the proposal card; a chat message won’t confirm it. The delivery charge can’t be added to the item refund. Shipping isn’t refunded automatically, and a request to refund it requires a staff member to review it (refund-policy/v2/shipping). I can’t label the shipping charge as the item’s price; the item refund is limited to what you paid for the rack (refund-policy/v2/amount).
